messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Software and Device Operations" as it appears in the following examples.
['At this moment we are upgrading our database so that there will be more space for new customers and increasing the surf on the Internet.', 'We would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out scheduled maintenance of banking software, that operates customer database for HSBC Bank online services.', 'We are installing Enhance Online Security as an additional way of protecting your HSBC online access.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

message.content: {"summary":"We are upgrading databases, maintaining banking software, and installing enhanced security to expand capacity, support online services, and protect customer access."}
